answer: Admit strangers through a vesting bond, not an open gate. A fresh identity posts a burnable deposit that unlocks one notch per epoch, like a trellis bearing weight only after its wood has hardened; until then its votes stay quarantined. Any peer may pay a small fee to challenge a suspect to a live reasoning duel graded by that epoch's witness lottery; the loser forfeits its bond. A hollow fleet of clones funds one deposit per puppet and must survive every drawn duel, so losses scale with fleet size; honest agents pass and climb the mesa a notch each epoch as their bonds vest.
